senses.gloss:
r. 2nd cl. (वष्टि)
To desire, to will, to wish.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Humbled, subdued, tamed, overpowered.
2 Enthralled, subdued by charms and incantations, fascinated, charmed, enchanted.
mn. (-शः-शं)
Wish, desire.
n. (-शं)
1 Authority, supremacy, mastership.
2 Subjection, submission, the state of being completely tamed and over-powered.
3 Birth.
m. (-शः)
The residence of harlots.
f. (-शा)
1 A woman.
2 A wife.
3 A daughter.
4 A cow.
5 A barren cow.
6 A female elephant.
7 A husband's sister.
E.
वश to desire, aff. अप्, fem. aff. टाप्.

r. 1st cl. (बषति)
To kill or hurt.

(औ) औवस r. 1st and 10th cls. (वसति वसयति)
To dwell or inhabit.
r. 2nd cl. (वस्ते)
To cover with dress, to wear as clothes.
r. 10th cl. (वासयति)
1 To be affectionate, to love.
2 To cut or divide.
3 To kill.
4 To accept.
(इर, उ) इरवसु r. 4th cl. (वस्यति)
To be straight, to be unbending; literally or figuratively.
With अधि prefixed,
To sit upon, to occupy.
With उप,
To fast.
With नि,
1 To dwell in or inhabit.
2 To dress.
With प्र,
To dwell abroad.
With सम्,
To cohabit.

f. (-सा)
1 The serum or marrow of the flesh, considered by some authorities as distinct from the marrow of the bones, though regarded by others as the same substance.
2 Adeps, fat, suet.
E.
वस to divide (in the body), अङ् and टाप् affs.

(ऋ) वाशृ r. 4th cl. (वाश्यते)
1 To sound.
2 To cry as a bird.
3 To call.

f. (-शा)
A plant, (Justicia ganderussa): see वास, and वासक; also with कन् added वाशिका.

r. 10th cl. (वासयति)
To introduce another quality, but especially fragrant odors, to perfume, to incense, to fumigate, &c.
(ऋ) वासृ r. 4th cl. (वास्यते)
To sound, especially as a bird.

m. (-सः)
1 A house, a habitation.
2 Site, situation, abode, or place of staying or abiding.
3 Cloth, clothes.
4 Perfuming.
mf. (-सः-सा)
A plant, (Justicia ganderussa.)
E.
वस to dwell, aff. घञ्, or वास to fumigate, aff. अच्.

f. (-का)
An obedient and docile wife.
E.
वश subject, कन् added.

mf. (-कः-का)
A shrub, (Justicia ganderussa.)
E.
वास to perfume, aff. ण्वुल्.

f. (-या)
Subduing or overpowering by drugs, gems, charms, or incantations.
2 The drugs, &c. so used.
E.
वश subjection, क्रिया business or agency.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Obedient, subject.
f. (-गा)
An obedient wife.
E.
वश subject, and ग who goes or is.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Subject, obedient.
E.
वश, and गत gone.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Submissive, acknowledging obedience or subjection.
E.
वश subjection, वद to speak, खच् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति)
Obsequious, acting under subjection, or according to the pleasure of another.
E.
वश, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.

m. (-कुः)
A bird.

m. (-कः)
A porpoise, the Gangetic porpoise.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Obedient, submissive.
E.
वश, and अनुग who pursues.

m. (-यी)
A dog.
E.
वशा subjection, पा to preserve, इनि aff., and युक् augment.

m. (-यी)
A dog.
E.
वसा, and पायिन् who drinks.

m. (-शिः)
Subjugating, fascinating, bewitching, holding others in magical or mysterious submission to one's will.
E.
वश to desire (supremacy), and इन् affix; also with तल् and त्व affs. वशिता and वशित्वं.

m. (-सिः)
1 Dwelling, abode.
2 A dwelling.
E.
वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. इन्.

m. (-शिः)
Fire.
E.
वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.

mf. (-सिः-सी)
A small hatchet or chopper, an adze.
m. (-सिः)
Abiding, dwelling.
E.
वस to abide, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Void, empty.
f. (-का)
Aloe wood.
E.
वश to desire, इन् aff., and कन् added.

f. (-का)
A plant. (Justicia): see वासक.

f. (-ता)
1 Fascinating, bewitching.
2 Subjection, holding in order or subjugation; also वशित्वं.
E.
वशिन्, and तल् or त्व aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Stored, (as grain.)
2 Dwelling, inhabiting.
3 Put on, worn.
n. (-तं)
Abiding, residence.
f. (-ता)
The power of subduing all things: see वशिता.
E.
वस to dwell, &c., aff. क्त, or वशिता as above, and श changed to स.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Perfumed, scented.
2 Sung, called, cried.
n. (-तं)
The cry of birds or animals.
f. (-ता)
1 A woman.
2 A female elephant.
E.
वाष to call, or वास to perfume, aff. क्त, and स changed to श.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Perfumed, scented.
2 Clothed, dressed.
3 Famous, celebrated.
4 Steeped, infused.
5 Spiced, seasoned, (sauces, &c.)
6 Peopled, populous, flourishing, (a country.)
7 Having, possessing.
n. (-तं)
1 The cry of birds.
2 Knowledge in general, but especially that derived from memory.
3 Sound.
4 Rendering a country populous and flourishing, causing it to be inhabited.
f. (-ता)
1 A woman.
2 A female elephant.
E.
वस to dwell, or clothe, causal form, or वास to call, (as a bird,) aff. क्त

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Subdued, subjugated, in subjection.
m. (-शी)
A sage with subdued passions.
f. (-नी)
1 The Śami tree, (Mimosa Sama, Rox.)
2 A parasite plant.
E.
वश, इनि, and ङीप् affixed.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Abiding, staying.
f. (-नी)
A white sort of Jhiṇṭi, (Barleria.)
E.
वस to dwell, घिनुण् aff.

n. (-रं)
Sea salt.
m. (-रः)
1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.)
2 A sort of long pepper.
3 Orris root.
E.
वश to desire, इरन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A pungent fruit resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis); also वशिर.

n. (-रं)
Sea salt.
m. (-रः)
A pungent fruit, considered as a sort of pepper, (Pothos officinalis.)
E.
वस to abide (in the sea), इरन् aff.; also, as derived from वश to desire, वशिर, &c.

m. (-ष्ठः)
VAŚIṢṬHA, a Ṛṣi or divine sage of the first order; he is also a Brahmādika, a Prajāpati, and one of the seven stars of Ursa Major.
E.
अव before शास to govern, to instruct, (the other saints,) aff. क्त, the first vowel of the prefix rejected; also written वशिष्ट and वसिष्ठ.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A celebrated Muni.
E.
वस to abide (in the practice of religious austerities), aff. णिनि, वसिन् superlative aff., इष्टन् added, pre-eminent amongst the ascetics; also वशिष्ठ, &c.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Relating to the sage VASIṢṬHA.
f. (-ष्ठी)
The Goomti river, which rising in the Kemaün hills, pursues a winding and south-easterly course, and passing Lucknow and Jonpur falls into the Ganges, below Benares.
E.
वशिष्ठ the saint, अण् aff., derived from him.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Explained or composed by the sage VASIṢṬHA, a part of the Vedas or a particular prayer, &c.
E.
वसिष्ठ, and अण् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Subduing or overcoming by drugs, charms, &c., enchanting, charming.
2 Subduing in general.
E.
वश subduing, and करण making, च्चि augment, leaving ई.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bewitched, fascinated, subjected to another's will.
E.
वशी, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Subjugated, subject to another's will.
E.
वशी, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Docile, tame, humble, governable.
2 To be tamed or humbled.
m. (-श्यः)
A dependant, a slave.
f. (-श्या)
A docile and obedient wife.
n. (-श्यं)
Cloves.
E.
वश subjection, यत् aff.

f. (-का)
An obedient wife.
E.
वश्या, and कन् added.

f. (-ता)
Humility, subjugation, disposition to, or fitness for subjection.
E.
वश्य, and तल् aff.; also वश्यत्वं.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Of subdued mind.
E.
वशी, and आत्मन् spirit.

ind.
An exclamation used on making an oblation to a deity with fire.
E.
वह to bear or convey, aff. डषट्.

m. (-र्त्ता)
The priest who pours the oiled butter into the fire at a sacrifice.
E.
वषट् an exclamation, &c., and कर्त्तृ who makes.

m. (-रः)
Burnt-offering, oblation with fire.
E.
वषट् the exclamation used on this occasion, and कार making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Offered or sacrificed with fire.
E.
वषट् as above, कृत made.

r. 1st cl. (वष्कते) r. 10th cl. (वष्कयति)
1 To see.
2 To go.

r. 1st cl. (वस्कते)
To go.

m. (-स्कः)
1 Application, perseverance.
2 Going, motion.
E.
वस्क to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-यः)
A one year old calf.
E.
वष्क to go, अयन् aff.

m. (-यः)
A calf of one year, a yearling.
E.
वस्क to go, अयन् aff.; also वष्कय, &c.

f. (-णी)
A cow bearing many calves.
E.
वष्कय a calf, णी to have, aff. ड and ङीष्; also वष्कय, with इनि and ङीप् aff., वष्कयिणी.

f. (-णी)
A cow bearing many calves.
E.
वस्कय a calf, णी to have, aff. ड and ङीप्; also वष्कयणी, &c.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सती-सत्)
1 Dwelling, inhabiting.
2 Wearing, as clothes.
E.
वस to dwell, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्)
Crying or singing like a bird.
E.
वाश to cry, aff. शतृ.

f. (-तिः or -ती)
1 A house, a dwelling.
2 Abiding, abode, residence.
3 Night.
E.
वस to dwell, अति Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.

n. (-नं)
1 Cloth or clothes.
2 Covering, clothing.
3 A dwelling, a house.
4 An ornament worn by women round the loins.
E.
वस to be clothed, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wearing, putting on, (as clothes.)
E.
वस to clothe, शानच् aff.

n. (-नं)
The cry or song of birds, bees, and the like.
E.
वाश to sound as a bird, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fit for clothes, or a dwelling, &c.
n. (-नं)
1 Perfuming, fumigating or perfuming with fragrant vapour, or with incense, &c.
2 Cloth, clothes.
3 Abiding, abode.
4 A particular posture in which abstract meditation is performed; it is also a posture conceived to be peculiarly proper in princes and chiefs, and is then described as sitting with the knees bent and the feet turned backwards.
5 Knowledge.
6 A water-jar.
7 A box, a basket, a vessel, &c.
8 An envelope.
9 Any receptacle.
10 Steeping, infusing.
f. (-ना)
1 The knowledge of any thing derived from memory, the present consciousness of past perceptions.
2 Fancy, imagination.
3 Trust, confidence.
4 Ignorance.
E.
वस to dwell, &c., aff. युच्; or वसन clothes, and अण् aff.

n. (-द्म)
A tent.
E.
वसन, and सद्मन् a dwelling.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Vasanta, the season of spring, or its deified personification.
2 Dysentery, diarrhoea.
3 Small-pox.
E.
वस to dwell, Uṇādi aff. झच्, as applied to the season, when love is especially present on earth.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
1 Placed, situated.
2 Vernal, relating to the season of spring, suitable to it, produced in it, &c.
3 Young, in the spring of life.
4 Diligent in the performance of religious ceremonies.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A camel.
2 The Indian cuckoo.
3 Any young animal, or a young elephant.
4 A catamite.
5 The southern wind, zephyr.
6 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus mungo.)
7 The black kind of Moong or bean.
8 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)
9 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
f. (-न्ती)
1 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
2 A species of jasmine, (Jasminum auriculatum.)
3 Long pepper.
4 Trumpet flower.
5 A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month Chaitra.
6 A species of the Śarkarī metre.
E.
वस to dwell, aff. झच्, and the vowel made long; or वसन्त spring, and अण् aff.

m. (-मः)
A tree, (Cordia myxa and latifolia.)
E.
वसन्त spring, and कुसुम a flower; blossoming in the spring.

m. (-षी)
The Indian cuckoo or Koïl.
E.
वसन्त spring, and घोषिन who sings.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in the spring.
f. (-जा)
A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA, held in the month Chaitra.
E.
वसन्त, and ज born.

m. (-तः)
1 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
2 The month Chaitra, (March-April.)
3 The fifth Rāga or musical mode, called also Hindola.
4 The mango tree.
f. (-ती)
1 The trumpet flower.
2 A large and beautiful creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
E.
वसन्त spring, and दूत the messenger.

m. (-द्रुः)
The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.)
E.
वसन्त spring, and द्रु a tree, or वसन्तद्रुम; the mango blossoms in March or April, and is then an object of great beauty.

m. (-खः)
KĀMADEVA or CUPID.
E.
वसन्त spring, and सखि the friend.

n. (-वं)
The celebration of the return of spring, formerly held on the full moon of Chaitra, but now on the full moon of Phālguna, being identified with the Dola yātra or Holi.
E.
वसन्त, and उत्सव a festival.

m. (-द्यः)
The Gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus Gangeticus); also वसाद्यक and वशाद्यक, the last perhaps incorrectly.

n. (-रं)
Wish, purpose, desire.

mn. (-रः-रं)
A day.
m. (-रः)
One of the Nāgas or serpents.
E.
वस to abide, in the causal form, Uṇādi aff. अर.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what wears.
E.
वस to put on, तृच् aff.

ind.
Having put on (as clothes), wearing.
E.
वस to wear, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
1 Sweet, sweet-flavoured.
2 Dry, dried.
n. (-सु)
1 Wealth, thing, substance.
2 A gem, a jewel.
3 A medicinal root, commonly Vṛddhi.
4 Water.
5 Gold.
6 A yellow kind of kidney-bean.
7 A sort of salt.
8 The number eight, i. e. the eight Vasus.
m. (-सुः)
1 A kind of demigod, of whom eight are enumerated, viz. DHAVA, DHRUVA, SOMA or the moon, VIṢṆU, ANILA or wind, ANALA or fire, PRABHŪṢA and PRABHĀVA.
2 A name of AGNI or fire.
3 A ray of light.
4 The tie of a yoke.
5 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
6 The name of a king.
7 A name of KUVERA.
8 A tree in general.
9 A lake, a pool.
10 A rein, a halter.
11 A plant, (Trophis aspera.)
12 ŚIVA.
13 The sun.
14 A kind of fish.
E.
वस to abide or dwell, Uṇādi aff. उ.

m. (-सुः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU.
2 The soul, or the SUPREME BEIṄG considered as the soul of the universe.
E.
वस to abide (eternally,) उण् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-सूः)
A young girl, (in theatrical language.)
E.
वस to abide, in the causal form, (to take to dwell with one,) aff. ऊ.

n. (-कं)
A fossil salt, brought from a district in Ajmere, Sāmbher salt.
m. (-कः)
1 A shrub, (Gigantic Asclepias.)
2 A tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding, or वसु wealth, कै to sound, aff. ड.

n. (-कं)
1 Sāmbher salt.
2 The Sesbana grandiflora.
E.
see वसुक; the उ of वसुक optionally long.

m. (-टः)
A supplicant, a beggar, a petitioner.
E.
वसु wealth, कीट a worm.

f. (-दा)
The earth.
E.
वसु wealth, and दा who gives.

m. (-वः)
VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA.
E.
वसु a Vasu, a deity, the incarnation of one of the Vasus; or वसु wealth दिव to shine, aff. अच्.

m. (-वः)
1 KṚṢṆA.
2 A descendant of VASUDEVA, the general appellation of a class of persons peculiar to the Jainas.
E.
वसुदेव the father of the deity, and अण् patronymic aff.

f. (-ता)
The constellation Dhaniṣṭha.
E.
वसु the Vasus, and देवता divinity; presiding over the asterism.

m. (-भूः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
वसुदेव, and भू born.

f. (-व्या)
1 The asterism Dhaniṣṭha.
2 The ninth day of the fortnight.

f. (-का)
Crystal.

f. (-धा)
The earth.
E.
वसु wealth, धा to have or contain, aff. क and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
वसुधा, and घर what holds.

m. (-पः)
A king.
E.
वसुधा, and अधिप sovereign.

n. (-रं)
The capital of VARUṆA in the western ocean.

f. (-रा)
1 A female Śakti peculiar to the Jainas.
2 The capital of KUVERA.
E.
वसु wealth, धृ to have, aff. घञ् and टाप्; some authorities read वसुभारा for KUVERA'S capital.

f. (-रा)
The earth.
E.
वसु wealth, धृ to have, खच् aff.

m. (-णः)
Fire or its deity, AGNI.
E.
वसु a Vasu, and प्राण life.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Wealthy, rich.
f. (-ती)
The earth.
E.
वसु wealth, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-चिः)
A religious ceremony in which the demigods called Vasus especially are worshipped.
E.
वसु as above, रुच to shine, इसि Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
A deity, a divinity.
E.
वसु wealth, ला to have, aff. क.

m. (-णः)
A name of KARṆA, the illegitimate brother of the PĀṆḌU princes.
E.
वसु wealth, and सेना an army; surrounded by hosts of beggars for his wealth, of which he was liberal.

f. (-ली)
The city of KUVERA.
E.
वसु wealth, स्थल place or site, aff. ङीष्.

m. (-ट्टः)
The Vakapushpa, (Sesbana grandiflora); also वसुहट्टक.

f. (-रा)
A whore, a harlot.

f. (-रा)
Night.
E.
वाश to sound, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.

f. (-रा)
1 Night.
2 The earth.
3 A woman.
4 A female elephant.
E.
वास to perfume, or वस to abide, in the causal form, aff. उरच्.

f. (-का)
A scorpion.

r. 10th cl. (वस्तयते)
1 To hurt or kill.
2 To go or move.
3 To ask, to beg, to solicit.

m. (-स्तः)
A goat.
n. (-स्तं)
A house.
E.
वस्त to kill, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ती-स्तं)
Made or derived from a goat.
E.
वस्त, and अण् aff.

f. (-दा)
A plant, (Ligusticum ajwaen): see अजमोदा.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be dwelt in, or inhabited, resided, remained at, &c.
E.
वस to dwell, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be abided or dwelt in, to be fixed as a habitation.
2 To be taken care of, (as a dependant.)
m. (-व्यः)
A kinsman, a dependant.
E.
वस to dwell, causal form, aff. of the future participle तव्यर्.

f. (-न्त्री)
1 Benzoin or storax.
2 A plant, commonly Ajaśṛṅgī.
E.
वस्त a goat, and अन्त्र entrail.

mf. (-स्तिः)
1 The lower belly, hypogastric or pubic region.
2 The bladder.
3 A glyster, syringe, or bag made of bladder or gut, with a wooden or metallic nozzle.
4 Abiding, dwelling, staying. plur. only (-स्तयः) The ends of a cloth.
E.
वस to wear as clothes, Uṇādi aff. ति, or वस to abide, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-द्यः)
The soap-berry, (Sapindus detergens.)
E.
